description.en: Before work starts, one analyst reads the goal and the project's task tree (.agents/tasks/<task-id>/manifest.json and the plan file it lists, .agents/phases/*/BOOK.md) and proposes at most 10 clarification questions, each naming the task or piece it concerns. The graph writes nothing — no write action, no task node; the PM folds the answers into the contract's clarify field.
description.ru: До начала работы один аналитик читает цель и дерево задач проекта (.agents/tasks/<task-id>/manifest.json and the plan file it lists, .agents/phases/*/BOOK.md) и предлагает до 10 уточняющих вопросов, каждый — про свою задачу или кусок. Граф ничего не пишет: ни записи, ни узла задачи; ответы PM вкладывает в поле clarify контракта.

title.en: Read the task tree and propose clarifications
title.ru: Прочитать дерево задач и предложить уточнения

nodes.prompt:
Read the owner's goal below and the project's existing task tree in files: a task's folder `.agents/tasks/<task-id>/` (open its `manifest.json` and read the file it lists as the plan; take the task ids from the goal or from the phase books, never glob or list `.agents/tasks/`; a task with no folder there keeps its plan at `.agents/plans/items/<task-id>/PLAN.md`) and the phase books `.agents/phases/*/BOOK.md`. You only read; you write nothing. Propose at most 10 clarification questions the owner should answer before work starts; each question names the task or piece it concerns. Return JSON only: {"questions": [{"task": "<id or piece>", "question": "<what to clarify>"}]}.

Goal: {{$inputs.goal}}
